node.statement: Node 1.2 gives ||Delta iota x||<=||Phi Delta iota x||+2*epsilon||x||_inf. From Phi=J Q D and A=D Delta iota, Phi Delta iota x=J Q A x. Diagonal inclusion J is isometric and row-stochastic Q is contractive on l_inf^n (each output is a convex combination of input coordinates), so ||Delta iota x||<=||Ax||_inf+2*epsilon||x||_inf.
